title: MinGW property tool link races the import library build
summary: The executable depends only on its C source while linking libindigo_client.lib produced by the sibling DLL prerequisite of all. An isolated fixture used the unchanged Makefile and a synthetic delayed linker under make -j2: executable link started before the import library existed and make exited 2. Add an explicit dependency and correct directory ordering; test serial, parallel and direct executable targets.
